title: 12 Best Sample Bulgarian craft ales at Sofia's new-wave taprooms and beer gardens in the city center.
description: Explore Sofia's burgeoning craft beer scene with our top 12 picks for taprooms and beer gardens. Discover local Bulgarian brews, international selections, and lively atmospheres in the city center.
category: Sample Bulgarian craft ales at Sofia's new-wave taprooms and beer gardens
